title: C1 output - keypoints for one delivery

conditions.description: Recording conditions, used by the ICC study

window.description: Delivery window: back-foot contact to ball release

filter.description: Smoothing applied by C1. C1 sends unsmoothed keypoints; C2 applies the Butterworth filter.

landmarks.description: 33 entries of [x, y, z, visibility] after normalisation; null when the keypoint is missing

reliability.description: Per keypoint name (top level, e.g. reliability.left_knee): ICC for the camera setup (angle + distance) the clip was filmed with and whether it passes the gate. Keypoints are only tagged, never removed from frames; C2 decides. Setup matched by the same angle and the exact distance, else the nearest studied distance within 2 m. No match: {"setup_matched": null, "note": "no reliability study for this setup yet"}

setup_matched.description: Studied camera setup the tags come from, null when none matches

examples: pilot ICC study (3 deliveries per setup)
no reliability study for this setup yet

band.description: not_enough_data = keypoint missing in too many deliveries to compute an ICC (icc null, usable false)
